# Dwellinger — llms.txt
# Version 1.1 — October 2026

## About Dwellinger

Dwellinger is a UK contractor trust and verification platform. Dwellinger Ltd (company no. 16871183, England and Wales, incorporated 24 November 2025) publishes Builder Score™ — a 0–1000 trust rating for every contractor on the platform, calculated from six verified components.

Registered office: 280-282 Church Road, Sheldon, Birmingham B26 3YH.
Contact: info@dwellinger.co.uk

## What Dwellinger does

Dwellinger enables homeowners and property professionals to find and verify building contractors across Greater London (all 32 London boroughs and the City of London) and the Home Counties.

Homeowners can: search contractors by trade, location, and Builder Score; verify contractor credentials and compliance history; read and submit verified project reviews; use free planning and estimating tools.

Contractors can: create a verified profile; receive and manage leads from homeowners and professionals; build their Builder Score over time; access a contractor dashboard.

## Builder Score™

Builder Score™ is a 0–1000 trust rating published by Dwellinger Ltd for every contractor on the platform. It is calculated from six verified components:

- Verified reviews: 35% (350 points) — reviews tied to completed projects with photos, dates and client confirmation
- CDM compliance record: 20% (200 points) — Pre-Construction Information, Construction Phase Plan and Health & Safety File for qualifying projects
- Payment behaviour: 15% (150 points) — supplier and subcontractor payment patterns; late payments, disputes and non-payment events
- Insurance and accreditation: 15% (150 points) — current public liability insurance, professional indemnity where applicable, trade body membership, identity check
- Dispute resolution record: 10% (100 points) — outcome of disputes lodged through Dwellinger or third-party resolution
- Response rate and platform activity: 5% (50 points) — lead response time, communication quality, platform engagement

Score tiers: Platinum 900–1000 / Gold 700–899 / Silver 500–699 / Bronze 0–499 / Unrated (new contractor).

Methodology v1.0 — published October 2026.

## Pricing

Free for homeowners. Contractor plans from £49/month. 14-day free trial, no card required. See /platform/pricing for full plan details.
